surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves the use of ozone as an oxidizing agent, with the metal precursors TDEAA and TDEAH. The surface reactions are self-limiting, with the growth rate leveling off due to surface saturation. The reaction mechanism includes the adsorption of the metal precursor, followed by an oxidizing pulse with ozone, and subsequent purging. The self-limiting nature of the process ensures that only a monolayer of the metal precursor is deposited per cycle.
